description:
观戏、跳水、看鱼，六七十年代皇家山原来这么好玩！ 
本集《Fun转时光》带你重返那个黄金年代，揭开“皇家山三宝”——国家剧场、范克里夫水族馆、里峇峇利泳池的往事。国家剧场曾是新加坡文化的亮点，大型演出一票难求；本地相声艺人陈兆锦也在这里度过最难忘的舞台时光。山脚下的范克里夫水族馆，是孩子们第一次“看见大海”的地方；旁边的里峇峇利泳池，更是每个假日都被笑声填满的玩水天堂。这些地标虽已消失，却仍闪耀在几代人的共同记忆里。一起点击播放，重温皇家山的昔日光辉！ 

Fort Canning was THAT happening in the 1960s and 70s! 
This episode of Re: Old Times uncovers the “three happening treasures” that once defined the area — the National Theatre, Van Kleef Aquarium, and the River Valley Swimming Pool. 
The iconic National Theatre was Singapore’s cultural powerhouse, and veteran performer Chan Chow Jin recalls its unforgettable energy. Just down the hill, the Van Kleef Aquarium amazed generations of children, while the River Valley Swimming Pool offered endless laughter and weekend adventures. 
These landmarks may be gone, but their stories continue to shape Singapore’s shared memory. Hit play and relive the charm of a Singapore that once was!

#SG60 #新加坡60
